```mermaid
        varchar key_id
        timestamptz sealed_at
    }
    audit_integrity_checks {
        uuid id PK
        timestamptz started_at
        timestamptz finished_at
        varchar trigger
        uuid requested_by_id
        varchar outcome
        integer events_sealed
        bigint entries_checked
        bigint last_sequence
        varchar chain_head
        integer problem_count
        jsonb problems
        integer unsealed_overdue
    }
    audit_events ||--o| audit_chain_entries : "event_id"
```

## Notifications: emails and SMS (logical)

```mermaid
erDiagram
    notifications {
        uuid id PK
        timestamptz created_at
        varchar channel
        varchar category
        varchar template
        jsonb recipients
        varchar subject
        text body
        text body_encrypted
        varchar status
        smallint attempts
        timestamptz next_attempt_at
        varchar last_error
        timestamptz sent_at
        varchar skip_reason
        varchar related_type
        varchar related_id
        uuid requested_by_id
    }
```

```mermaid
    }
```
